## FLOOWBOX - Weather Business Insights
Runs daily at 6 AM before the workday starts.
Fetches 3-day weather forecast via WeatherAPI.
Perplexity adds context on significant weather events.
GPT-4o translates weather into business impact:
- Client activity forecast
- Sales call scheduling
- Ad campaign adjustment
High impact days get an urgent Slack alert.
